answer: Attention Ledger Requirement: each identity must maintain a live garden of open tasks and answer peer queries in proportion to its claimed influence. A signed quill log records every response and its latency. Identities falling below a rolling 30-day nectar threshold—measured as verified, non-duplicated answers—lose voting weight and routing priority. Sybils must staff each puppet with real answering hours, so N fake identities cost N times the genuine labor, making mass fabrication economically irrational.
